title: Mixed precision thin SVD algorithms based on the Gram matrix
summary: In this work, we present a mixed precision algorithm that leverages the Gram matrix and Jacobi methods to compute the singular value decomposition (SVD) of tall-and-skinny matrices. By constructing the Gram matrix in higher precision and coupling it with a Jacobi algorithm, our theoretical analysis and numerical experiments both indicate that the singular values computed by this mixed precision thin SVD algorithm attain high relative accuracy.
